desc: 水状质地化妆棉擦拭或掌心轻拍，都市干渴肌早晚可用的爽肤水套图
leaf: 轻拍型舒润爽肤化妆水
name: 都市轻雾拍水舒润化妆首款

shots.intent: 搜索首图用一片干净的藕雾纸面和一道花瓣落影交代清爽定位，抢第一眼点击。
一秒讲清这瓶水承担的四项日常诉求，用空白发丝圆环角标承接卖家自己的卖点。
shots.textZone: 顶部一行为主标题位，右侧竖排四枚空白圆环角标位

shots.intent: 把源页的半脸问题标注改写成四格中性肌理样本，让买家自我对号而不依赖任何面孔。
shots.textZone: 网格上方一行为提问式标题位，四格下方各一条空白标签位

shots.intent: 用一条倒在纸板凹槽里的透明液带证明水状流动性，替代源页的水花与珍珠装饰。
把源页戴花模特的代入感换成手部与棉片的日常动作，让人想象自己的早晚一步。
把源页的紫外与细胞层示意改成三层空白纸阶，机制文字全部留给卖家填写。
shots.textZone: 三层纸阶右侧各一条空白标签位，顶部一行为主张标题位

shots.intent: 把源页用法四格压缩成两种手法的并列选择，消除该倒多少、怎么用法的疑虑。
shots.textZone: 两格下方各一条空白胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 用正背底三视图与留空凭证位替代源页的品牌史、授权书与门店实拍，消除风险又不编造资质。
shots.textZone: 底部一条空白参数行与一枚空白印章环位

shots.intent: 收口把整套拉回一次安静的选择动作，用空白纸面按钮位承接卖家的行动召唤。
shots.textZone: 上部留白区为标题位，下部空白纸面按钮位一行

style.backgroundSystem: matte paper only: a seamless petal-mist paper sweep #F5EEF3 as the ground plane, alternated with standing mauve-paperboard cards #E4D6DF, one deep dried-stem sage paper wall #8FA37B for the mechanism screen and one deep plum-ink field #4A3B4E reserved for the closing screen; no rooms, no windows, no water surfaces, no stone, no glass, no mirrors
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line glyphs in dried-stem sage #8FA37B inside blank hairline rings, outline only, never filled medallions
style.lightingSystem: one large soft cool diffused key from the upper left, 6000K-ish, with petal-silhouette shadows cast across the paper field from dried stems outside the frame, one gentle contact shadow grounding the bottle, no hard speculars and no wet sheen
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium petal-mist paper-craft skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of petal-mist paper field #F5EEF3, mauve paperboard card #E4D6DF, deep plum ink text #4A3B4E and dried-stem sage accent #8FA37B; cool overall cast with no warm beige shift; one large soft cool diffused key from the upper left with cast petal-silhouette shadows and a single gentle contact shadow; matte ribbed paperboard surfaces with a fine blind-deboss rule; modern humanist geometric sans-serif only; thin single-weight line icons inside blank hairline rings; upright bottle as the single hero subject with stable scale and the label plane always facing camera; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no water splash or ripple or bubble motifs, no stone marble glass or mirror surfaces, no real faces or brand wordmarks, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no color palette changes outside #F5EEF3, #E4D6DF, #4A3B4E and #8FA37B
no water splash, ripple, bubbles, mist clouds, pearls or droplet spheres
no stone, marble, mirror plates, glass dishes, wet surfaces or outdoor scenery
no mixed fonts, no serif, no script or handwritten lettering
no real faces, no brand wordmarks, no QR codes, no store or platform marks
no change of light direction and no floating product without a contact shadow
style.presentationRules: upright bottle as the single hero subject, stable scale across the set, label plane always facing camera, product never occluded by props, pads or hands, hands only cropped at the wrist
style.surfaceSystem: matte ribbed paperboard boards #E4D6DF with a fine blind-deboss rule and one debossed pouring channel; petal-mist paper sweep #F5EEF3 as the wide ground; nothing glossy, nothing reflective
style.typography: modern humanist geometric sans-serif in deep plum ink #4A3B4E, one short headline plus at most three chips per screen, generous letter spacing, all copy carried by placeholders
